answer: The marble of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, converted to a slow vesting stream, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. A terrace of per-task receipts records who did what, and the orchard of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
